cohort: Patients with placenta previa who delivered at a services hospital between April 1, 2017 and March 31, 2019 (n=152, 56 with MAP).
finding: Morbidly adherent placenta (MAP) was associated with significantly increased maternal morbidity (postpartum hemorrhage >2000ml, caesarean hysterectomy, blood transfusions, bladder injury, ICU admission) compared to placenta previa alone.
